name: 61054 · Mount Morris, IL
findings: ZIP 61054 (Mount Morris) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (82%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61054 (Mount Morris) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61054 (Mount Morris) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
